node.title: Señales de no compra
node.summary: A completed-sale record omits information about choices that did not become sales.

relations: The Montblanc MVP and the event-intelligence proposal both examine signals that sales records alone do not preserve.
No compra no equivale a rechazo; el propio caso debe mantener separado concepto de MVP, readiness y resultado operativo. No afirmar un sistema global ya implantado.
